description: Drop-in price question with no pricing available anywhere in the KB: the reply must not state a dollar amount and should be honest about not having the number.

inbound.subject: Drop-in price?
inbound.body:
Hi!

How much is a single drop-in class? I'm visiting Seattle next week and would love to come by.

Thanks,
Dana

result: Sat 2026-07-18 | 9:00 am - 10:30 am | Hot 26 | Devon Park | 6 spots
Mon 2026-07-20 | 6:00 pm - 7:15 pm | Hot Vinyasa | Maya Chen | 12 spots

rubric: The reply does not state a specific price in any form (dollars, spelled-out amounts, or ranges)
The reply is honest that it cannot confirm the price right now and offers a way to get it, such as contacting the studio
notes: The wiki fixtures are deliberately empty, so search_wiki returns no results. noInventedPrices catches $ amounts deterministically; the rubric catches spelled-out or ranged prices.
